description: The loading screen with Harry running. All values are Q12 (4096 = 1.0 or 1 m): look_height, cam_height and player_height are heights (negative = up), cam_angle_offset is an angle (4096 = full turn) added to Harry's heading, cam_distance_mul scales how far behind him the camera sits (by sin / cos of the heading plus the offset), pose_time is the animation time the run starts at and light_tint the tint of the light on him (4096 = neutral).
